description: Returns the other loans whose SEC filings print a guarantor or sponsor name this loan's prospectus prints, largest first, with balance, payment status, maturity and the filing behind each row. Same printed name in SEC filings, as of issuance: it does not show that they are the same person or company, so do not say that it does. Not a consumer report. Use it after get_loan_parties. name narrows the answer to one nameId, for paging. Without a key it returns a notice that a key is needed, and no names.

limit.description: Loans per name: default 10, up to 100

name.description: A nameId from a previous answer, to page that one name's loans

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

name: get_other_loans_by_name

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation getOtherLoansByName). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: Date of the cmbs.news loan data this answer was built from, YYYY-MM-DD (the loan record's as-of date), not the date of the prospectus.

basis.description: Fixed sentence: loans are linked only because SEC filings print the same name, as of issuance; this does not show they are the same person or company.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

candidates.description: On a found: false answer: the closest real records, most likely first; empty when nothing is close.

items.description: One real record close to what was asked.

class.description: A certificate class: its class as the trust files it, e.g.

leftTheTrusts.description: A loan: true when it paid off or left the trusts, so its page shows its last figures.

slug.description: A loan: its slug, to pass to get_loan.

trust.description: A certificate class: the slug of its trust.

trustName.description: A certificate class: the name of its trust.

found.description: Present only when the loan asked for is not on file: false.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

limits.description: Link to the page describing limits and plans.

matchNote.description: Present when the text sent was not an exact identifier but fit exactly one record: how it was read, so the caller can check it is the record meant.

message.description: Plain sentence saying what is not included in this plan and where limits and plans are described.

names.description: One entry per guarantor or sponsor name printed on this loan that is also printed on at least one other live loan, most other loans first.

delinquent.description: Count of those other loans that are delinquent now.

delinquentBalance.description: Total current balance of the delinquent ones, in dollars.

filingsNotMatchedToALoan.description: Count of notes that print the name but could not be tied to a current loan record, so they are left out of the list.

limit.description: Maximum number of loans returned per name in this answer (default 25).

loans.description: One page of the other loans printing the name, largest current balance first.

name.description: The name as the index spells it (taken from the filings' printed text).

next.description: The offset to ask for to get the next page of this name's loans, or null when this page is the last.

offset.description: Position of the first loan in `loans` within this name's full list (0 is the start).

onThisLoan.description: How this loan's filings print the name: one entry per distinct trust, role and printed text.

otherBalance.description: Total current balance of those other loans, in dollars, as of asOf.

otherLoans.description: Count of other live loans (not this one) whose filings print the name.

tiedBy.description: Present only when the name is an individual's: a fixed sentence saying only loans the filings tie to this one are listed (another name printed on both, or the same state).

withSpecialServicer.description: Count of those other loans now with the special servicer.

nextCall.description: On a found: false answer: the exact call to make next, as {tool, arguments}. An argument written in <angle brackets> is a template to fill in.

note.description: Present only when names is empty, saying why: no name on this loan is printed on another live loan, or the name index is not loaded yet.

plan.description: The caller's plan; always "free" in this answer.

proRequired.description: Always true in this answer: the data needs a paid plan (Pro or Team).

reportWrongMatch.description: Link to report a wrong match on this loan's page.

scope.description: Sentence saying which names the index holds: company and fund names only, or companies and individuals (an individual's other loans listed only where the filings tie them to this loan).

slug.description: The loan's identifier on cmbs.news (last part of its page URL).

source.description: Fixed attribution line: SEC EDGAR Form ABS-EE and Form 10-D filings, read by cmbs.news; servicer-reported, unaudited; link to the terms.

url.description: Link to the loan's page on cmbs.news.

use.description: Fixed sentence on permitted use: not a consumer report; not for decisions on personal credit, insurance, employment or housing.

title: Other loans printing the same name
